text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r l-a-u-n-c-h-e-d b-u-l-k a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n t-r-i-e-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-e-r-v-e-r a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l-s w-i-t-h a-b-n-o-r-m-a-l t-o-k-e-n i-s-s-u-e s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l-s.
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-v-e-r-t-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d v-a-l-u-e-s i-n-t-o w-i-t-h-d-r-a-w-a-l b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a o-f f-r-e-q-u-e-n-t s-m-a-l-l t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-t-i-f-r-a-u-d t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the a-c-t-o-r s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s t-o b-l-u-r t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-h-r-o-n-o-l-o-g-i-c-a-l l-o-g o-f r-e-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e s-k-u s-e-l-e-c-t-i-o-n-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
4) the a-c-t-o-r f-r-a-m-e-d t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s e-v-e-n-t-s a-s s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t r-e-c-o-v-e-r-y a-c-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-o-r-r-u-p-t-e-d s-u-p-p-o-r-t t-i-c-k-e-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t t-h-r-e-p-a-r-t-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p-s.
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e a-u-t-o-m-a-t-i-o-n s-c-r-i-p-t-s i-n t-o o-b-f-u-s-c-a-t-e o-r-i-g-i-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-i-l-e s-y-s-t-e-m m-o-d-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-o-u-r-c-c-o-d-e r-e-v-i-e-w p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s.
